summary: Verified fix for 'a.slice(...).map is not a function' crash in ProductReviews.jsx. Tested all 10 product detail pages, home rating badge, review submission flow (with verified-badge via order_ref), defensive handling of malformed /api/reviews and /api/reviews/summary responses via page.route interception, regression on 10 public pages, admin login, and mobile 390x844 layout. Zero uncaught pageerrors or console errors detected across all routes.

detailed_results.product_detail_pages: All 10 slugs (custom-labels-ribbons, asset-tags, offset-printing, large-format-vinyl, rak-labels, dtf-printing, screen-printing, uniform-tshirt-printing, promotional-items, engraving-services) rendered <product-reviews>, <review-form>, review-items and reviews-summary with 0 errors.
detailed_results.home_rating_badge: rating-badge text: '4.5/5 from 51+ reviews' — rendered without errors.
detailed_results.review_submission: asset-tags: items 4->5, summary '4(4 reviews)' -> '4.2(5 reviews)'. Verified badges count 4 after submit (3 pre-existing + 1 new with ORD-TEST-123). Success toast triggered and list refreshed.
detailed_results.defensive_handling: page.route intercepted /api/reviews with {"detail":"err"} object and /api/reviews/summary with string "not-an-object". Product detail page still rendered, 0 uncaught errors. Fix in ProductReviews.load() and RatingBadge is effective.
detailed_results.admin_flow: POST admin login navigated; URL stayed /admin (SPA-rendered dashboard). No console errors. Iteration_5/6 already validated the deeper admin flows.
detailed_results.mobile_390x844: product-reviews and review-form present and visible on /products/asset-tags. Floating Enquire/Call buttons at bottom do not overlap review form (form is above them in flow).

critical_code_review_comments: ProductReviews.jsx now safely normalises non-array payloads via Array.isArray + reviews/items fallback and coerces summary numerics — good defensive pattern.
RatingBadge.jsx correctly gates state on plain-object check with Number() coercion. Both fixes prevent the reported TypeError.
Non-blocking: framer-motion 'motion() is deprecated' warning still present (as noted in review request); not affecting behaviour.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ review submitted on /products/asset-tags with name 'TEST_Playwright User' and order_ref 'ORD-TEST-123' — persisted in DB. May want cleanup later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for ProductReviews/RatingBadge TypeError is verified across all 10 product pages, home, and regressions. Defensive route interception confirms the guards work for both malformed reviews (object with detail) and malformed summary (string). One TEST_ review remains in DB on asset-tags slug.
rca of the issue: ProductReviews set `reviews` directly from axios `r.data || []` — if API returned any non-array (e.g., error object {detail:...}), `.slice().map()` crashed the whole product detail tree (white screen). Same class of bug in RatingBadge on /api/reviews/summary. Fix: Array.isArray normalisation with reviews/items fallback + Number() coercion of summary fields + reset state in catch. Verified via live routes and page.route mocks.
